name: ExtensionSubscriptionTopic_NotificationShape
title: R5: Properties for describing the shape of notifications generated by this topic (new)
purpose:
This extension is part of the cross-version definitions generated to enable use of the
element `SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape` as defined in FHIR R5
in FHIR R4.

The source element is defined as:
`SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape` 0..* `BackboneElement`

*  R5: `SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape` 0..* `BackboneElement`
